subtitle: Landmark Travel & Campus Tours
promotional_text: Explore 2,200 famous buildings in 156 cities on a 3D map, hear their stories read aloud, save cities for offline and collect a stamp at each. Plus 117 college campuses.
whats_new:
New in 2.8
• Save for Offline: keep a city's landmark photos and Wikipedia stories on your device for flights and trips abroad. Maps and events still need a connection.
• Listen: hear any landmark's story read aloud, with your phone in your pocket.
• 16 new architecture cities: Munich, Hamburg, Glasgow, Bilbao, Valencia, Rotterdam, Chandigarh, San Diego, Savannah, Charleston, Baltimore, Kansas City, Fort Worth, Palm Springs, Oak Park and Columbus, Indiana. 156 cities in all.
• 5 new campuses: Colorado State, Eastern Michigan, Michigan Tech, Oakland and Central Michigan. 117 campuses in all.
• More places to stay: compare hotels on Booking.com next to Expedia, and find vacation rentals on Vrbo, from the trip planner and landmark pages.
• More tours: Viator next to GetYourGuide on every city landmark.
• Library, museum and city event calendars in 11 cities, now including Honolulu and Miami.
• iPad: a wider sidebar, a full-screen World Map, larger sheets, and a Passport that opens on a country you've stamped.

Fixes
• Large photos load quickly instead of showing "No photo available".
• Events with many time slots show once.
• Cleaner Game Day titles, and "Time TBA" when a game has no start time yet.
• Your best quiz score is saved when you finish the quiz.
• On iPhone, page text no longer shows through behind the top bar when you scroll.
description:
Stamped! turns the world's great buildings into a passport to fill. Explore more than 2,200 architectural landmarks in 156 cities and 117 university campuses, earn a stamp for every one you visit, and fly through real cities on a photoreal 3D map.

PLAN YOUR COLLEGE VISITS
• 117 campuses: every Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 school, the Ivy League, and great campuses around the world
• Save the schools you're considering to My College List
• Make a College Road Trip: a day at each school, in a short driving order
• Plan a Campus Visit: a one-day walking tour of a campus's landmarks
• Find hotels near campus for each night of your trip

CAMPUS TRADITIONS
• Over 250 campus traditions to do or see, from lucky statues to bells and famous gates
• Check them off as you go and earn the Traditions Keeper badge
• Campus stamps in school colors

PLAN ANY TRIP
• Plan several days of landmarks and your own saved places
• Reorder stops, see walking times and optimize your route
• Fly through your trip on the 3D map, day by day
• Your trips and college list sync with iCloud
• Restaurants, hotels, tours and local events around your stops
• Compare hotels on Expedia and Booking.com, or find a vacation rental on Vrbo
• Save a city for offline: its landmark photos and stories stay on your device

EXPLORE IN 3D
• Photoreal 3D city and campus maps with satellite imagery
• A guided tour that flies between every landmark
• Look Around previews of the streets before you go
• Map filters for food, coffee, culture and places to stay

COLLECT STAMPS
• Earn a passport stamp for every landmark you visit
• Follow your progress on the world map, by city, country and conference
• Unlock achievements and share your passport
• See your progress at a glance with the Home Screen widget

DISCOVER THE STORIES
• Architects, build dates, styles and history for every building
• Listen: hear any landmark's story read aloud
• A 10-question architecture quiz for every city and campus
• Search by name, architect or campus nickname
• Architect pages, photo galleries and historic photos from the Library of Congress

Available in 9 languages, with high-contrast and reduced-motion options.

Stamped! is not affiliated with or endorsed by any university. School names and colors are used only to identify them.
